usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog, and Jumpseller receives each new item when “New Product” runs “Create Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Product” in Jumpseller
bestTemplate.why: A product added in Shopify appears in the second store without being typed twice.

watchOut: “New Product” fires only on creation, so later edits need their own “Update Product” template.
